transcript:
**Agent:** Thank you for calling TechSolutions, this is Alex speaking. How can I assist you today?

**Customer:** Hi Alex, I’m having issues with my subscription. I got charged twice this month, and I don't understand why.

**Agent:** I’m sorry to hear that! Let me pull up your account and take a look at the billing details for you. Could you please provide your email address associated with the account?

**Customer:** Sure, it’s jane.doe@example.com.

**Agent:** Thank you, Jane. One moment while I check your billing information. **[pause]** Alright, I see that you were indeed charged for both your monthly Pro plan and an additional feature add-on. Did you authorize that add-on?

**Customer:** No, I definitely didn’t! I only wanted the Pro plan.

**Agent:** I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the mix-up. I can help you with a refund for the add-on charge, if that works for you.

**Customer:** Yes, please. Can you also explain how I can avoid this in the future?

**Agent:** Absolutely! I recommend reviewing your account settings in the login portal, where you can manage your subscriptions and any add-ons. I can guide you through it if you’d like.

**Customer:** That would be helpful. Also, is there any chance to keep my plan at a lower rate? I’ve seen some competitors offering discounts.

**Agent:** I completely understand. We can offer you a 10% discount on your renewal if you choose to stay with the Pro plan for another year. Would that help?

**Customer:** That sounds fair! I’ll take that. How do I proceed?

**Agent:** Great! I’ll process the refund for the additional charge and apply the discount to your annual renewal. You’ll receive a confirmation email shortly.

**Customer:** Thank you so much, Alex! This was really helpful.

**Agent:** You're very welcome, Jane! If you have any further questions, feel free to reach out. Have a wonderful day!

**Customer:** Thanks, you too!
